rule: fit_protocol.md is the living prose protocol. When a general protocol pins it by sha256 and the text later changes, the exact pinned bytes are kept as a frozen file NAME@VERSION.md, recovered from git history (never retyped). The protocol YAMLs keep their pin on docs/fit_protocol.md; protocols/tools/validate.py resolves a pin that does not match the living file by hash to the frozen version. VERSION is the general protocol version that pins the text; when several versions pin the same bytes, one file named after the first of them, its pinned_by listing them all.
